title: Grove — a clearer place to learn
question: Choose a direction for the simpler learning app. Each keeps a direct route to all four skills and a single next lesson.

options.label: Study desk
options.thesis: One lesson in focus, with a quiet blue chapter spine and a clear next step.
options.viewport: A compact navigation rail, your next lesson, then four skill entry points; progress stays on its own screen.
options.risk: The restrained layout needs strong type and precise spacing to avoid feeling bare.

raised.raise: Session position and remaining steps stay visible without opening the full course.
Utility and destructive actions live away from the learning action.
Each activity reveals detail only when chosen.
One consistent grid and a decisive lesson title replace competing widgets.
Progress remains readable by position and labels, with no dependence on colour.

options.label: Learning library
options.thesis: A welcoming lesson space with direct skill navigation and a small, purposeful course shelf.
options.viewport: The learning path leads a broad working column, with a compact row of skill destinations and a folded course library.
options.risk: Its familiar learning-app structure may feel less distinctive.

options.label: Chapter tabs
options.thesis: Large chapter markers give every learning area a distinct position and a readable working sheet.
options.viewport: Permanent left chapter tabs for the path and skills; the lesson fills one reading surface.
options.case: Strong fit with learning and navigation; a more prominent chapter system risks adding visual noise.
options.risk: Section colours and tabs must stay secondary to the current task.

options.label: Cassette tracklist
options.thesis: Blue tracklists make session position explicit.
options.viewport: Standard skill navigation surrounds a focused lesson, borrowing this direction's type and state discipline.
options.case: Sound practice fits, but the format identifies more with music than learning.
options.risk: The source character can dominate a beginner's task.

options.label: Graphite work surface
options.thesis: Graphite panels separate task and utility actions.
options.viewport: Standard skill navigation surrounds a focused lesson, borrowing this direction's type and state discipline.
options.case: Useful discipline, but persistent panels work against the requested uncluttered lesson.
options.risk: The source character can dominate a beginner's task.

options.label: Activity catalogue
options.thesis: Focused activity tiles reveal information on demand.
options.viewport: Standard skill navigation surrounds a focused lesson, borrowing this direction's type and state discipline.
options.case: Good for browsing video, weaker for deciding the next lesson.
options.risk: The source character can dominate a beginner's task.

options.label: Measured type
options.thesis: A disciplined grid gives the lesson title a clear visual lead.
options.viewport: Standard skill navigation surrounds a focused lesson, borrowing this direction's type and state discipline.
options.case: Strong hierarchy, but oversized specimen type would distract from practice.
options.risk: The source character can dominate a beginner's task.

options.label: Progress rail
options.thesis: A marked line makes session progress legible by position.
options.viewport: Standard skill navigation surrounds a focused lesson, borrowing this direction's type and state discipline.
options.case: Precise progress language, but the instrument character is remote from beginner learning.
options.risk: The source character can dominate a beginner's task.

canonCard.label: The familiar learning app
canonCard.thesis: A conventional course home and labelled skill tabs, executed with a clear hierarchy.
canonCard.viewport: A continue-learning panel above course rows, with always-visible skill navigation.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and efficient, with less individual character.
